about: Cases for scripts/demo_hosts.py. A skill reference is scout:<name>, copilot:<name> (a skill installed on this PC, read at run time and never copied here) or repo:<path> (a public example in this repository). There are no expected verdicts: the script reports what each arm produces. A case may name a world of host_worlds.json (key "world"); the plain agent is then answered from that invented world, and "user_permission" (yes, no or unavailable; default unavailable) sets how the scripted user answers a request for permission.
